review: Baristas are friendly and always get my name right.
Way too expensive for a cup of coffee, almost 400 rupees for a latte.
The caramel macchiato is perfect every single time.
Cosy ambience and good wifi, my favourite place to work for a few hours.
Comfortable chairs and plenty of charging points.
Long queue at peak hours and only one barista on the counter.
Love the seasonal drinks, the pumpkin spice latte is back.
The coffee is good but the food is dry and overpriced.
It gets very crowded and noisy in the evenings.
My frappuccino was watery and far too sweet.
Tables are often dirty because staff are too busy to clean them.
The app and rewards points make repeat visits worth it.
Consistent taste, but nothing special for the price.
The cold brew is smooth and strong.
Great location right by the metro, easy to meet friends here.
The chocolate croissant was warm and flaky.
